projects.name: Streaming player
projects.description: Web and TV player: adaptive streaming, captions, playback analytics.

cards.title: Player 2.0 — accessible playback for the winter season
cards.intent: Every programme plays with captions and audio description on web and TV, with playback analytics we own.
cards.constraints: WCAG 2.2 AA. Data stays in Switzerland. No new paid SaaS.
decisions: No Kafka: playback events stay on Postgres LISTEN/NOTIFY

children.title: WebVTT track picker in the control bar
Caption styling (size, contrast) saved per viewer
Keyboard and screen-reader pass on the control bar
Playback events table and retention job
Stream playback events to Kafka for the analytics team
children.description: The analytics team asked for a Kafka topic with every play / pause / seek.

children.title: Remote-control focus order on the TV player
Resume where you left off across web and TV

projects.name: Newsroom assistant
projects.description: Tools for the editors: transcripts, summaries, fact-check queue.

cards.title: Morning desk — transcripts and summaries before 7:00
cards.intent: Editors find the night's interviews transcribed, summarised and searchable when they arrive.
cards.constraints: Swiss-hosted inference only. A human validates every published summary.
decisions: Summaries are never published without an editor's approval

children.title: Ingest the night recordings from the archive bucket
Summary card with sources and timestamps

projects.name: Archive search
projects.description: Search 60 years of programmes by what is said, not only by title.

cards.title: Archive search — pilot on the 1990s news
cards.intent: A journalist finds a 1990s clip by a sentence said in it, in under ten seconds.
cards.constraints: Rights metadata respected: a clip without broadcast rights is listed, never played.

children.title: Search UI for the pilot editors
